name: Blairgowrie Yacht Squadron
signature: One of the Peninsula's most active bay sailing clubs — keelboat and dinghy racing, strong junior programs, and a foreshore location between Sorrento and Rye
editorNote:
The Blairgowrie Yacht Squadron is one of the more active sailing clubs on the bayside of the Peninsula — a mixed fleet of keelboats and dinghies, regular racing through the season, and a junior program that has been producing Peninsula sailors for decades. The club sits on the bay foreshore at Blairgowrie with good views across toward Williamstown and the You Yangs.

Racing days bring the foreshore to life — worth watching from the beach if you're passing through on a weekend.
whyWeGo: Active bay racing in one of the quieter foreshore spots between Sorrento and Rye.
ifOnlyOneThing: Check the race calendar — club racing days make the Blairgowrie foreshore worth a stop.
